#Identifier to uniquely specify a patient.	Patients have clinical benefit when mRECIST response is different than Progressive Disease.	Clinical stage of cancer.	Pathway that is being targeted by the ICI treatment.	Drug used for the treatment. Combination therapies, where more than one drug is administered, are represented by the name of both drugs.	What is the target of the ICI drug.	Progressors are defined as patients with mRECIST of Progressive Disease.	Responders are defined as patients with mRECIST of Partial Response or Complete Response, whereas Non-Responders are those with Progressive Disease or Stable Disease.	Original tumor tissue subtype.	Sex	Overall Survival Status from first application of PD-1 blockade to date of death	Overall Survival (Months) from first application of PD-1 blockade to date of death	Progression-Free Status from first application of PD-1 blockade to date of death	Progression-Free (Months) from first application of PD-1 blockade to date of documented disease progression
